skill.name: material-component-doc
skill.description: Guides FlowGram material component documentation, including source review, Story creation, MDX structure, screenshots, and Chinese to English translation.
skill.summary: Create consistent FlowGram material component docs and examples.
skill.author: bytedance

security_audit.summary: All static findings were reviewed against the skill files. The alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, visible documentation examples, React Story sample code, and documentation hyperlinks; no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Markdown code fences and inline backticks trigger noisy command execution alerts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples visible and documented, and avoid presenting optional commands as automatic actions.

remediation.issue: The template includes an npx CLI example that users may run manually.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short note telling users to review package commands before execution.

remediation.issue: Documentation templates contain placeholder external links.
remediation.suggestion: Replace placeholder URLs with verified project links before publishing generated docs.

content.value_statement: FlowGram material docs need consistent stories, API tables, source notes, screenshots, and translation steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through that workflow.
actual_capabilities: Guides source discovery for FlowGram material components.
Defines Story component naming and React.lazy usage rules.
Provides an MDX template for examples, APIs, and source notes.
Explains screenshot naming, storage, and document embedding.
Guides Chinese to English documentation translation after user approval.
Lists quality checks for links, commands, diagrams, and examples.
limitations: It assumes the FlowGram repository layout used in the skill.
It does not verify component behavior without running the docs site.
It needs user examples for specialized component scenarios.
It does not replace reviewer approval for translated documentation.

use_cases.title: Create a New Component Doc
use_cases.description: Draft a complete material component page with examples, API tables, source notes, and image guidance.

use_cases.title: Prepare Story Examples
use_cases.description: Create Story components that match FlowGram naming, wrapper, type, and lazy loading conventions.

use_cases.title: Translate Approved Docs
use_cases.description: Translate confirmed Chinese MDX pages into English while preserving code, paths, links, and formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FlowGram material component documentation draft for [component name]. Ask me for missing examples before writing advanced sections.

prompt_templates.title: Build Story Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [component name] and propose the required Story examples. Include basic use, disabled state, schema use, and component-specific cases.

prompt_templates.title: Complete API Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the source for [component name] and create API tables for props, related config types, providers, hooks, and exported utilities.

prompt_templates.title: Finalize and Translate
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the approved Chinese MDX for [component name], check links and diagrams, then produce an English version with unchanged code blocks.

output_examples.input: Document a new variable selector material component.
output_examples.output: A structured MDX page outline with introduction, screenshot placement, story demos, API tables, source walkthrough, and dependency notes.

output_examples.input: Prepare Story examples for a component with schema filtering.
output_examples.output: A Story plan covering basic use, schema constrained use, disabled state, and custom filtering behavior.

output_examples.input: Translate an approved Chinese component document.
output_examples.output: An English MDX draft that preserves component names, code blocks, internal paths, external links, and Markdown structure.

best_practices: Confirm the component source path before drafting documentation.
Ask the user for real usage examples before writing advanced cases.
Translate only after the Chinese document is approved.
anti_patterns: Do not invent props, defaults, hooks, or exported APIs.
Do not translate code blocks, commands, paths, or component names.
Do not publish placeholder links or diagrams without review.

faq.question: Which project is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for FlowGram material component documentation in the repository layout described by the skill.

faq.question: Can it create Story components?
faq.answer: It guides Story creation with naming, lazy loading, wrapper, and type rules. The generated code still needs project validation.

faq.question: Does it support English documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It translates approved Chinese MDX to English while preserving code, paths, links, and structure.

faq.question: Does it require screenshots?
faq.answer: Screenshots are optional, but the skill explains when to capture them and where to store PNG files.

faq.question: Can it verify API accuracy automatically?
faq.answer: It guides source review and API extraction, but a maintainer should confirm props, defaults, and exported APIs.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
